items.title: Evidence Ladder for Literature Review
items.summary: A short guided activity that helps students separate strong mathematical sources from weaker background references before they write a project plan.
items.excerpt: Learners compare four references, sort them by mathematical usefulness, and explain which source should anchor the first project review.
